name: lumi-player
description: Reproductor de música web en TypeScript basado en una lista doblemente enlazada

scripts.test: esbuild tests/list.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=tests/.list.cjs --log-level=error && node tests/.list.cjs && esbuild tests/youtube.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=tests/.yt.cjs --log-level=error && node tests/.yt.cjs && esbuild tests/storage.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=tests/.storage.cjs --log-level=error && node tests/.storage.cjs
scripts.serve: npm run build:site && npx --yes serve site
